gpt.text:
I can’t execute those commands from here, but you can run them locally/in CI exactly as listed. Here’s what each will do and what to look for in the outputs.

## 1) Run AUB autopilot (module-level) and select best
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best
```
**Purpose:** Runs candidate module variants defined in `module_registry.yaml`, evaluates them, and (with `--select-best`) promotes the best-performing candidate to be the new champion if it beats `baseline/champion_v5_latest.json` under your selection criteria.

**What to check after:**
- A new/updated champion file (or symlink) if promotion occurs.
- Any generated report artifact(s) summarizing means/mins and pass/fail gates.
- Whether any candidates were rejected due to minimum/lockbox constraints.

## 2) Run system autopilot (end-to-end/system candidates)
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run
```
**Purpose:** Runs end-to-end system-level candidate configurations from `system_candidates.yaml`. This typically catches integration regressions and performance tradeoffs that module-level tests miss.

**What to check after:**
- A system report comparing candidates vs the current champion.
- Any “INCONCLUSIVE” results (usually due to variance, flaky tests, or insufficient samples).

## 3) Generate the next-fix recommendation report
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```
**Purpose:** Produces a prioritized “what to fix next” plan based on latest results and registry metadata, written to `baseline/reports/next_fix.md`.

**What to check after:**
- The top suggested fixes (often weakest modules by min/lockbox behavior).
- Any notes about instability or missing evaluations.

---

If you paste the stdout/log summaries (or the generated report snippets), I can help interpret which candidate won, whether it truly beats the champion given your `tuning_mean/min` and `lockbox_mean/min`, and what the next fix should target.
